observations: [release-diff] Release 2.0.0 adds pipe-leakage and surface-flooding beneath water-damage, multilingual labels, and a SpecificCause readiness shape; no triples are removed. Structural differences do not establish semantic equivalence.
[release-diff] AT:WD and CZ:VODA retain exact mappings to water-damage. Narrowing becomes enabled and still requires a source assertion.
[change-impact] The report lists 50 changed records: 40 classifications narrow to pipe-leakage, and six records change from sufficient to incomplete. Ten records remain unresolved.

[change-impact] Nine consumers are affected: CQ01, CQ07, CQ16, CQ17, source-peril-map, readiness-v2, claim-fact-card, case-header, and get_case_context. CQ16 examples show classification and readiness can change independently.

[candidate-validation] Findings include conflicting causes for CLM-AT-005 and CLM-CZ-005; overlapping versions of POL-AT-009 and POL-CZ-009; currency violations for CLM-AT-010 and CLM-CZ-010; missing loss dates for CLM-AT-003 and CLM-CZ-003; AT clause applicability gaps; and a missing CZ mitigation assessment.
[candidate-validation; change-impact] Narrowed classifications coexist with other validation failures, so classification alone does not establish readiness.
